claim: Vera is proactive, not just reactive: given what she has actually OBSERVED, she asks 'what could I OFFER that would HELP?' and surfaces — at most one at a time, paced like a gentle aside — a warm, optional, easy-to-decline OFFER grounded in real evidence (a STALLED + significant stated project: 'you've mentioned the podcast for months — want me to help sketch a milestone plan?'; an often-mentioned UNEXPLAINED entity; a DECLINING thread). There are NO generic tips: if the evidence isn't there, she stays silent. The ONE non-negotiable invariant is OFFER, NEVER ACTION — an opportunity is a proposal STRING; the engine reads the life signals and APPENDS to its own offer ledger and does NOTHING else. It never sends a text, writes a reminder, touches a calendar, calls route, or invokes any executor. If the user says 'yes', the acting flows through route.py's existing draft->confirm->execute gate on the user's explicit next turn — never here. A 'no' is respected (not nagged); an already-offered opportunity is not re-offered.
owner: anima/opportunity.py (opportunities = grounded read over loops+meaning+curiosity, trajectory optional/defensive; next_opportunity = at most one paced offer or None; render_opportunity/render; read_budget pacing dial; the append-only OFFER ledger ledger_path/read_ledger/mark_offered/mark_response/decline = the ONLY writers, all recording OFFERS not actions; binds NO route/host_access and exposes NO execute/send/do/act primitive), anima/server.py (the proactive aside in _turn: on a casual cloud-off turn, opportunity.next_opportunity(name) -> last_opportunity_choice -> mark_offered, the offer appended to the user-facing reply tagged _aside_kind="opportunity")

known_gaps: The proactive aside fires only on a CASUAL turn (answered, no capability/host/reference/repair/known-fact reply owns the turn, cloud-off for PII, once per session): the SELECTION + APPEND wiring is proven deterministically here through the same functions the server calls, but the base reply text that the offer is appended onto comes from a live model turn, so the full in-situ surfacing of the appended line is exercised only under Ollama (not in this offline cert).

The richness of opportunities scales with the live engines: a thin life (few loops, little significance, no high-mention entities) yields few or no offers — by design (Observed > Assumed; no generic tips). The trajectory engine is read purely defensively and only sharpens a declining-thread's confidence; the engine is complete without it.
